name: Dimensional
inspiration: Studied from short-form motion work circulating Oct 2026 (compound.mov promo reels): chrome display type turning inside a tunnel of screens, instrument-style ring readouts with a lens fringe, and the creator's own posts floating in 3D as social proof. Original cards, built from the ideas rather than the assets.
summary: Objects in space. Real CSS perspective, polished chrome type, thin instrument linework with an RGB lens fringe, on a near-black canvas. Use when the subject should feel engineered and expensive rather than friendly.

palette.notes: Colour is almost absent on purpose. The chrome ramp and the warm/cool fringe pair ARE the palette; the blue accent is for live readouts only. Mirror into tokens.css.

motion: Heavy and slow. Big objects arrive on expo.out over 1.2-1.8s and settle; nothing snaps. Idle drift is sine.inOut on mismatched periods so floats never bob in unison.
transitions: Push in from depth (z) rather than slide in from an edge. Exits pull back into the throat.

cards.notes: Headline reads best as ONE word. Two short words fit; a phrase will not.
The trace is a fixed path, NOT audio-reactive. Never tell a client it responds to their track.
Transparent overlay. Keeps clear of a face guard at x 660-1260, y 300-1080. Use for the social-proof beat.
